No, they can't be stacked. A promo code can't be combined with Leafy Plus member pricing (the 10% off pots and accessories) on the same item. If both apply, the system automatically gives you whichever discount is better, so you don't need to choose.

A couple of related points:
- Only one promo code can be used per order.
- Promo codes can't be added after an order is placed, so if you're planning to use one, apply it at checkout.

If your promo code is on a different item in the same order, such as a plant, it can still apply to that item. The restriction is only on combining the two discounts on the same item.
